tutorial.text: TUTORIAL

Brace yourself stranger, for an unearthly ride.
I'm Madam Leota, your mysterious guide.
Press a number for the ghost to be selected,
or click on the portraits, to each ghost they're connected!
TUTORIAL
I can use my ball and chain to press the floor switches to open secret passageways.
TUTORIAL

Happy Haunts can be found in many places,
Standing around in several spaces,
found in objects and enemy foes,
what they were doing there, nobody knows!
TUTORIAL

To get through each room and make your way free,
find Happy Haunts to get the Skeleton Key.
TUTORIAL
I can carry items in my bag - that vase should fit nicely! I should probably put the vase on the other pedestal...which would undoubtedly activate its button!
TUTORIAL

Eye of newt and root of tree,
First you must find a Skeleton Key.
To release the ghosts and escape this place,
look for Happy Haunts in every space!
TUTORIAL
I can pass through the glowing paintings. Click on the painting and see where I materialize.
TUTORIAL
Use me to light the candelabra with my fireballs in order to see the way.
TUTORIAL

Select this book to record your place
and do not worry if you leave this space,
even if all your energy is gone,
this is the spot from where you will move on.
TUTORIAL

Under your portraits, you will behold
a glowing red bar surrounded by gold,
if it becomes empty, then you will be sent
to the book or entrance of this event.
TUTORIAL
My fireball will scare the Black Widow Bride away!
TUTORIAL
Beware, the Black Widow Spiders will harm us. Use my bag to trap them!
TUTORIAL
I can use my ball and chain to smash these haunted armor to pieces.
TUTORIAL

Phineas will help you with this next test,
no windows or doors so do your best.
Find portrait pieces strewn all about,
then match them up to find your way out!
TUTORIAL
That secret door needs three more vases to open.
TUTORIAL

This cursed door will lead nowhere new,
seek yet another which you can pass through.
TUTORIAL

Now that you have passed through a door that's unhexed,
explore this new room to find out what is next.
TUTORIAL

Alter the time by knocking on doors,
each moves the hand by a few or some more
The ghostly chest that remains now unseen,
will reveal itself when the clock strikes 13!
TUTORIAL

That coffin is trapping an unfortunate spirit,
that's begging for help, listen close can you hear it?
To open the coffin and answer its cry,
you must find an object with which you can pry!
TUTORIAL

A crowbar can pry open the coffin's stone seal,
hurry and see what the casket reveals!
TUTORIAL

The Mansion needs searching a little bit more,
To find the way to open this door.
TUTORIAL

The Mansion needs searching a little bit more,
To find the way to open this door.
TUTORIAL

The dancing ghosts seem to be playing a game,
and taking the wedding gift which you must reclaim.
Hurry and snatch it when it reappears,
or else you'll be facing the worst of your fears.
TUTORIAL

This hat rack currently bears two of the five,
hats of the husbands when they were alive.
I see visions of you going free,
if you can find and return the missing three.
TUTORIAL

From the beyond I hear a sad call,
that seems to be coming from inside that brick wall.
Free and release it from this horrible state,
or suffer yourself a more terrible fate.
TUTORIAL

How do you take down a wall built of brick?
Conjure a tool that will do just the trick.
TUTORIAL

The Mansion's spirits have done you in,
but don't lose hope, you still can win
Your spirit energy has been revived
So continue on, and look alive!

story.text: THE BLACK WIDOW BRIDE
What a lovely necklace. Not quite as lovely as me, of course. But I've misplaced my other necklaces. Find them or you'll find yourself trapped here forever!
THE BLACK WIDOW BRIDE
Another pretty bauble! Find more to fill my jewelry box or you will never leave!
THE BLACK WIDOW BRIDE
It takes a lot more than this necklace to appease me! Hurry! Before I lose my patience and you lose your life!
THE BLACK WIDOW BRIDE
I promise to loath, horror and punish... Another necklace! But this is not all of them!
THE BLACK WIDOW BRIDE
If anyone here who objects to this unholy union... ah, another beautiful necklace! But there are still more!
GEORGE
Please help me! Only fancy jewelry can distract my bride long enough for me to escape! I was given the axe and have been trapped in my own home ever since!
GEORGE
I've waited centuries for my freedom. Thank you brave stranger!
AMBROSE
All I've wanted for more than 100 years is to go back to my parents' farm. Please distract my deadly bride and help me leave this cursed Mansion.
AMBROSE
This is the best day of my afterlife! I can finally go home!
FRANK
Thank you stranger! I'd be eternally grateful if you could preoccupy my bride with this necklace so I can make tracks. Being stuck in that casket almost made me lose my head...again!
FRANK
I knew that pearl necklace would keep her busy, I can finally leave this cursed place!
MADAME LEOTA

I call on the spirits in my seance room,
who tell me you've met some unlucky grooms.
That you've made it this far is truly impressive,
perhaps you might escape the bride so obsessive.
MADAME LEOTA

My book is protected by a powerful spell,
to meddle with it would not bode you well.
MARQUIS
Curse my wretched bride for trapping me here for eternity! You must distract her long enough for me to escape. I'm so tired of being treated like a pinhead!
MARQUIS
I've longed to return to my home country for so long! I shall never forget this, thank you.
REGINALD
What good will it do to release me? I cannot escape this purgatory as long as the Black Widow Bride watches me!
REGINALD
Can this be? I'm really free!
HAPPY HAUNTS
You've set us free! At long last! Here's a key for your troubles.
HAPPY HAUNTS
Finally! We're free! As a token of gratitude, take this key.

menu.text: The ghostly Black Widow Bride is one of the former residents who chose to stay in the Mansion in the afterlife. Help the Hitchhiking Ghosts release 999 Happy Haunts and find their way out before they become her next victims.
This will permanently clear all progress! Are you sure?
Use the mouse to help the three hitchhiking ghosts escape before time runs out.
Phineas can move through glowing paintings, pick up small objects, and capture spiders.
Ezra can use fireballs to light candelabras and scare away the Black Widow Bride.
Gus uses his ball and chain to defeat ghostly armor and trigger floor switches.
Release enough Happy Haunts to receive a key to the exit.
Free all 999 Happy Haunts and all five husbands to escape the Haunted Mansion!

Even though you've made it through all the rooms,
you remain trapped here with all of the grooms!
Your earlier steps you must soon retrace,
and find all the Happy Haunts to escape this place!

Creepies and crawlies, lizards and leeches,
you got away from the Black Widow Bride's reaches!

Few have escaped, and many have died,
when they have crossed paths with
the Black Widow Bride!

Too bad!
Our hitchhiking ghosts have run out of energy...
Our hitchhiking ghosts will continue to the next level.
